caption: The drawing depicts a single square-shaped piece of fabric, possibly a handkerchief or lace, rendered in shades of beige and light brown. The fabric is shown with its upper and right edges scalloped in a repeating rounded pattern, each scallop containing a floral motif. There is an elaborate floral embroidery design in the center, featuring large and small flowers, leaves, and curving stems. The detailing uses fine lines to give the texture and shading of the cloth and stitching. Some smaller sprigs and clusters of dots are distributed near the corners and edges. The fabric’s surface appears slightly translucent with visible crosshatching, and the background of the drawing is plain and off-white. There are no other objects or elements present in the composition.
title: Wedding Veil
